THSTI Junior Data Scientist Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Junior Data Scientist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Junior Data Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Data Scientist position at THSTI is scheduled for 12 October 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Data Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech./M.Sc./M.Tech. in Computer Science/Data Science/Statistics/Biostatistics/Applied Mathematics, or a B.Sc. in the same fields with at least two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Data Scientist position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Data Scientist post is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Data Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Data Scientist post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Data Scientist position announced by THSTI.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Data Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, Skill Test, and Interview to assess the suitability of the candidates for the role.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Data Scientist is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), Faridabad, Haryana, 121001.
